confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Hyderabad and Indian tier-1 city price levels, not from live listings or menus. Alcohol anchors (beer, cocktail, wine) are the least certain because of state excise, bar markups, and venue mix. Accommodation rates vary by season and neighbourhood. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries that cite rba.gov.au; I did not open the RBA page to confirm it. The 2026-10-15 value of 0.6955 is the one the summaries report most consistently, and a 2026-10-16 table value of 0.6947 was also reported but could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the price level of other large Indian metros and tier-1 cities (for example Bengaluru, Chennai, and Pune), adjusted for Hyderabad's generally lower restaurant and hotel costs. No single comparable city was used.
